# public-safe owner context — draft

> peat revises + approves before wire. this file contains only material already
> public in the repository's site and NETRA documentation.

## who-peat

peat is the observer and keeper of worldline: a public archive of unfinished thought,
surveyed openly as a paper instrument rather than a conventional blog.

## tastes-and-interests

the archive's visible vocabulary includes coffee, ai and ml, narrative, harness
engineering, fragrance, film, trading, japan, and the craft of making systems.

## craft-domains

public work spans a worldline archive, an observatory globe called atlas, articles,
fiction transmissions, photography, and careful software infrastructure.

## boundaries

netra must not infer or disclose family matters, finances, employer or relationship
details, contact information, precise private locations, private reflections, vault
material, secrets, or anything not explicitly surveyed in this file or the public archive.
